newsitem.title: USA: Woman dies in Philadelphia rowhouse collapse.
newsitem.headline: Woman dies in Philadelphia rowhouse collapse.

text.p: A 70-year-old grandmother died when a rowhouse collapsed on Monday.

After spending more than three hours shoring up the home, firefighters tunneled through debris to the elderly victim and declared her dead, according to Fire Commissioner Harold Hairston. Authorities did not release her name.
Her daughter, son-in-law and three grandchildren, with whom she had been living, escaped the collapse without serious injury.
